# mergeah_application_credentials (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler application_credentials. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_application_credentials" "example" {
}

locals {
  application_credentials = jsondecode(data.mergeah_application_credentials.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) Filter by external ID.
- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.
- `slug` (String) Filter by connector slug.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
